part_number.product: SEL-421-7 Line Protection, Automation, and Control System (with Sampled Values or TiDL Technology)

prefix.description: SEL-421 Protection, Automation, and Control System

part_number.note: 25-digit MOT string for the SEL-421-7 (WI-13777, the Sampled Values / TiDL variant — the only current SEL-421 ordering-information doc). Positions 6, 15, 16, 18, 20, 22 are anchored by the SEL-421-7 master drawing layers (i7208/i7209/i7211/i7212 family, groups GROUP_1..GROUP_6). Positions 8, 11, 12, 13, 24, 25 are fixed template digits. Because this is the SV/TiDL doc, positions 6/7/9/14 carry SV-subscriber (X) and TiDL (R/T) codes in addition to the standard screw/connectorized publisher codes. A separate older SEL-421 (21-digit, prefix 0421...) and SEL-421-7-early families exist in the drawings but have no standalone ordering-information doc.
